findings.detail: C01 counts debt rows whose source interest-rate cells are intentionally dashed for undrawn or unfunded delayed-draw and revolving-credit positions, not extraction-missing coupons.

rationale: The C01 failure is a coverage threshold failure: 134 of 171 debt rows have rates, below 0.8. Raw source rows show the residual class includes delayed-draw or revolving-credit positions where the filer prints '-' for both reference/spread and Interest Rate and also '-' par, with small negative cost/fair-value balances. Comparable funded rows in the same schedule carry SOFR spreads and interest-rate cells. The stored blanks therefore match the source for these residual rows; the check is over-scoped to rows that do not disclose a coupon in the schedule.
